claim: Five tasks were routed to a click-shaped verb and needed a completely different control structure. With them repaired, the route table itself became the next defect: 21 goal templates match more than one pattern, and first-match-wins silently re-routed a task that already worked.

measurement.instrument: full 130 tasks x 5 reps, page identity per rep, exclusive CDP browser
measurement.note: measured BEFORE the ordering regression was found; see regression below

generate-number.shape: a generator loop, not a click

odd-or-even.shape: a whole-table condition, not a click

button-delay.shape: a timed sequence, not a click

find-greatest.shape: a comparison over values, not a reference

regression_found_and_fixed.cause: SORT the numbers ... starting with the LOWEST NUMBER matched the new FIND_VALUE pattern, and VERB_PATTERNS is FIRST-MATCH-WINS with FIND_VALUE placed above SORT. The task was silently re-routed to a verb that looks for cards.
regression_found_and_fixed.fix: FIND_VALUE moved below SORT; drag-sort-numbers 8/8 and find-greatest 8/8 after the move.
regression_found_and_fixed.law: ADDING A PATTERN TO A FIRST-MATCH-WINS TABLE IS A CHANGE TO EVERY PATTERN BELOW IT.

instrument_bug_of_the_round: A number regex written as /-\\d+/ requires a LEADING MINUS, so '7' never matched and the function reported 'no cards' on a page with three. Three consecutive patches were aimed at the escape instead of at the pattern.
